scenes.name: backdrop
scenes.still: A bright modern kitchen counter in white marble, soft morning light from a window on the left, shallow depth of field, out-of-focus shelves and green plants behind. The centre foreground of the counter is empty. No products, no bottles, no people, no text, no logos. Vertical photograph, photorealistic, advertising quality.
scenes.motion: Slow, steady push-in. Light shifts gently across the counter. Nothing else moves. No objects appear.

scenes.name: footage
scenes.still: A Vietnamese woman in her thirties standing in a bright modern kitchen, smiling with relief at a stack of clean white plates on the counter. No products, no bottles, no text, no logos. Vertical photograph, photorealistic, advertising quality.
scenes.motion: She looks down at the plates, then up toward the camera and smiles. Slow push-in. She does not speak.

narration: Sáng nào cũng vội, bếp nào cũng bừa.
Chỉ một lần rửa, chén đĩa sạch bóng.
Xem chi tiết sản phẩm ngay hôm nay.
